H68 Series · Outdoor Gateway

IP68 | High Capacity | Wide Coverage

The Hitelecom H68 outdoor gateway is an industrial LoRa gateway for wide-area sensor networks: up to 10 km coverage, -140 dBm sensitivity, 20-27 dBm transmit power and regional bands including CN470, EU868, US915 and AU915. The IP68 enclosure is designed for long-term outdoor service, with 4G backhaul and MQTT uplink.

Key Features

IP68 | High Capacity | Wide Coverage
  • Communication Range up to 10 km (Open Area)
  • IP68 Waterproof and Dustproof Rating
  • Industrial 8-Channel Full-Duplex Gateway
  • Supports local deployment for data control and reliability
  • Integrated Power Amplification and Low-Noise Amplifier Circuit
  • Wireless options: 4G LTE, NB-IoT, and LoRa.
  • Large-Capacity Networking, Remote Control and Data Acquisition
  • Can send a power-loss alert when backup power and backhaul remain available
Technical Specifications
The H68 series supports long-distance transmission up to 10 kilometers, reaching up to 2 kilometers within urban areas. It integrates 4G LTE, Ethernet, and Wi-Fi connectivity options to support reliable, continuous data transmission.

One rooftop gateway can collect data from many sensors across a site.

Covers solar farms and wind sites with long-range sensor backhaul.

Plant-wide sensor collection without per-sensor SIM cards.

Frequently Asked Questions

What coverage does the H68 outdoor gateway provide?
Up to 10 km in open conditions with -140 dBm sensitivity and 20-27 dBm transmit power. Real coverage depends on terrain and antenna height — Hitelecom can estimate it from your site plan.
Which frequency bands are supported?
CN470, EU868, IN865, RU864, US915 and AU915 — covering deployments in China, Europe, India, Russia, North America, and Australia.
How does the gateway backhaul data?
Over 4G cellular (LTE-TDD B34/B38/B39/B40/B41, LTE-FDD B1/B3/B5/B8) with MQTT uplink to Hitelecom Cloud or a private platform.
Is the H68 suitable for long-term outdoor installation?
Yes. The IP68 enclosure is dust-tight and waterproof, and the industrial design targets long-term outdoor service.
